name: Grand InHotel Kota Kinabalu
detail: A really nice hotel at an affordable and reasonable price! The hotel is very clean, well-maintained, and beautifully decorated. The room was neat and comfortable, and the bathroom was spotless too. Everything was well taken care of. The location is definitely a big plus. It’s right in the heart of Inanam town, so getting around is easy. There are plenty of places to eat nearby, and the hotel is located above a shopping complex with several food outlets downstairs. It’s especially convenient during the day and in the evening, although some shops may close at night. The swimming pool is pretty good and suitable for young children to enjoy, and there’s also a comfortable gym for those who want to keep up with their workouts. The breakfast was surprisingly good too! For the price we paid, it was definitely worth. Another nice touch was the coffee machine with free refills, so you could enjoy as many cups as you liked. The coffee was really good! Overall, everything was great. Clean rooms, good breakfast, friendly service, convenient location, and family-friendly facilities. Definitely good value for money. Would happily stay here again! ❤️ Onther things is there are rm100 depo need to be prepare during check in

name: Palette Kota Kinabalu Near by Imago Shopping Mall Formerly Zara's Boutique Hotel
detail: Saya sangat berpuas hati menginap di Zara’s Boutique Hotel. Biliknya kemas, selesa dan lengkap dengan kemudahan asas. Staf di kaunter sangat ramah dan mesra, sentiasa sedia membantu. Lokasinya pula sangat strategik — berhampiran dengan Imago Shopping Mall, restoran dan tempat menarik di sekitar Kota Kinabalu. Parkir juga mudah disediakan. Harga berpatutan dengan kualiti servis yang diberi. Sangat disyorkan untuk yang inginkan penginapan tenang dan selesa.

name: Homy Seafront Hostel
detail: In the city center, right across is the sea, especially on the third floor, the sea view is truly healing. I stayed for two days, and it was very clean and safe. The store manager is very nice and even gave me a big flower keychain. Signing up here for the island-hopping to Gili Islands is really much cheaper than on the app. I also saw a rainbow when I went to Gili. Breakfast is free 24 hours, and it took me less than 10 minutes to walk to Gaya Street, maybe because my legs are relatively long.

name: Signel Poshtel
detail: Everything is neat, reasonably priced, and in a great location. There is a shared kitchen with a pot that provides hot water immediately, a sink, a microwave, and a water purifier. It’s good to have microwave meals or instant noodles in the early morning. You can cook with an electric stove, and the refrigerator and freezer are spacious and perform well. The air conditioner works well. Make sure to get a room with a window and a private bathroom. The shared shower room and shared sink are also useful. There’s a smart TV from Samsung that allows you to watch Netflix and YouTube. You’re close to YouTube, E-Pang, and Kopiping. Batallas is right in front, and everything is within walking distance.

name: Cititel Express Kota Kinabalu
detail: I stayed at the Tree Full Room. It's about the size of an average business hotel (7 pyeong), making it good for a 1-2 night stay. It's very clean and well-maintained as it was just remodeled not long ago. The bathroom is also very clean. I gave up on the shower head since it couldn't be detached, but I don't know about other rooms. The TV is also LG, and both mirroring and Chromecast work well. It's right in front of the Hilton, just a 2-minute walk away, or 30 seconds if you run. There's also a great place for breakfast or lunch right in front, as well as a convenience store open 24 hours; everything you need is there.

name: Mercure Kota Kinabalu City Centre
detail: This hotel has an excellent location, easily accessible to major shopping areas by walking, which is convenient and quick. The rooms are spacious and very clean, ensuring good sleep quality. The facilities are complete, and the staff is enthusiastic and attentive, making the overall value for money outstanding. It was a very satisfying accommodation experience.

name: Promenade Hotel Kota Kinabalu
detail: I had an absolutely amazing stay at this hotel. The rooms were spotless, spacious, and featured modern decor with extremely comfortable beds. The staff were incredibly friendly and went out of their way to ensure we had everything we needed. The breakfast buffet was a highlight, offering a wide variety of delicious local and international options. Its central location made it very easy to explore the city's main attractions. I will definitely be returning!

name: Citadines Waterfront Kota Kinabalu
detail: Pros: Cleanliness, modern interior, quality of the pool, staff attitude, free coffee, close proximity to the night market, large refrigerator, basic kitchenware provided, small but useful sink, etc. Cons: Loud prayer sounds waking me up at 5 AM, far from restaurants as it's only close to the night market, terrible water pressure in the shower, room is too small to fit two suitcases.

name: The LUMA Hotel, Kota Kinabalu, a Member of Design Hotels
detail: A couple of days ago, I stayed at Hyatt Regency, which was mediocre, but then I moved to Luma and was pleasantly surprised. It's a really nice boutique hotel with a tastefully designed small lobby. The standard room was very clean, adequately sized, and the bathroom had no odor, with plenty of hot water and sufficient air conditioning. Free drinks were provided, including tea, coffee, coke, and water... The hotel occupies an entire building, and there are many eateries nearby, serving Malaysian, Italian, Chinese, and Korean cuisine. There is a large mall, Imago, across the street. The location is close to the airport, about a 15-minute drive. I recommend it.
